name: ABVD (DOXOrubicin / Bleomycin / Vinblastine / Dacarbazine)

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft decision-support protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: ABVD is a moderate-to-high emetogenic combination; give antiemetic prophylaxis before each administration per the standard emetic-risk framework.

supportiveCare: Bleomycin carries cumulative pulmonary toxicity risk; obtain baseline pulmonary function tests and monitor for pneumonitis, hold bleomycin for pulmonary toxicity.
Growth-factor support is generally not required with ABVD; do not routinely delay for asymptomatic neutropenia (dose density matters).
Baseline LVEF before anthracycline; track cumulative doxorubicin exposure.
monitoring: CBC with differential before each administration
interim and end-of-treatment FDG-PET (Deauville) for response adaptation

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: ABVD 'A'. DOXOrubicin 25 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. ISMP tall-man. Anthracycline cumulative cardiotoxicity: warn approaching 450 and hard cap 550 mg/m2. Standard first-line ABVD dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Bleomycin
drugs.notes: ABVD 'B'. Bleomycin 10 units/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. Pulmonary toxicity risk: PFTs before use, monitor for pneumonitis, hold for pulmonary toxicity. Standard ABVD dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Vinblastine
drugs.notes: ABVD 'V'. Vinblastine 6 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. IV only. Standard ABVD dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Dacarbazine
drugs.notes: ABVD 'D'. Dacarbazine 375 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. Standard ABVD dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).
